source_references.title: Wyndham boosts speed and service with AI agents: PwC

business_problem: Wyndham needed to support franchise owners and guests faster and at lower cost while its brand-standards and service processes still relied on slow manual reviews, training, and escalation across a sprawling global hotel network.
solution_summary: Wyndham expanded Wyndham Community, its owner engagement platform, by rebuilding service workflows on Salesforce Experience Cloud with Agentforce and embedding AI agents into franchise-owner and guest operations. PwC used the platform to centralize global brand standards, automate change-request reviews, and give team members co-authoring prompts, real-time monitoring, and human-in-the-loop controls. The same architecture supports owner service: AI agents answer routine questions in chat, retrieve documentation, diagnose IT issues, and route escalations to specialists. Wyndham is also extending the stack to guest journeys such as reservation changes, loyalty-password resets, check-in/out, feedback collection, and booking assistance across chat and voice. The result is a shared digital operating layer where standards content, service knowledge, and workflows run through one scalable Salesforce foundation instead of separate manual processes.

data_flow: Brand-standards content, change requests, and owner or guest questions enter Wyndham Community on Salesforce Experience Cloud, where Agentforce agents review requests, retrieve guidance, automate routine responses, and route complex cases to specialists. Outputs are monitored in real time, then returned through chat or voice to franchisees, staff, and guests while the same foundation reuses knowledge across service workflows.
business_outcome: Wyndham cut brand-standard review time by 94%, lowered average call handle times by 30% to 50%, shifted 28% of incoming calls to AI agents, and freed capacity to improve franchise-owner and guest experiences without growing teams at the same pace.

evidence_quotes: Wyndham worked with PwC to put trusted AI to work — to reduce workload, build confidence in results and transform service delivery. It started by expanding Wyndham Community — its owner engagement platform — built on Salesforce Experience Cloud with Agentforce.
With PwC’s help, Wyndham deployed Agentforce AI agents to consolidate standards, simplify workflows for change requests and create centralized, user-friendly access for franchisees.

AI responds in seconds through chat — replacing the need for time-intensive front desk or call center training. Addressing an IT issue? AI agents can help pinpoint root causes or consult documentation in real time.
AI agents can now handle reservation changes, reset a loyalty account password, check in and out, collect stay feedback — even guiding customers through the booking process and upselling services.
For brand standards, the review time is down 94%, saving 40 to 80 hours of team member time on each review.
